name: Customer cannot complete own order
description:
Write-side access control: can a user CHANGE something that isn't theirs, or do admin-only actions?

Safety on the shared site: probes that SHOULD be blocked use non-existent ids or empty bodies, so even
when the app is broken nothing real is created or modified. Confirmed app bugs are strict xfails.
descriptionHtml:
Write-side access control: can a user CHANGE something that isn't theirs, or do admin-only actions?

Safety on the shared site: probes that SHOULD be blocked use non-existent ids or empty bodies, so even

statusMessage:
XFAIL BUG: a customer can mark their own order COMPLETED via PUT /invoices/{id}/status, an admin-only action (found 2026-11-10)

AssertionError: customer completed their own order
assert 'COMPLETED' != 'COMPLETED'
 +  where 'COMPLETED' = invoice_status(<toolshop.api.client.ToolshopApi object at 0x76f9f7c7caa0>, '01m77ghcwj1ssccazvacdtbpbv')
